cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Name My Contribution
cards.instruction: Get them to acknowledge exactly what your effort, sacrifice, or strategy added to the result.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. When you thank the festival team, mention who repaired the stage in the rain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Wonderful. Which equal sentence includes my waterproof trousers?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You want your name in the speech?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Beside the part that kept the dancers above ground.

mechanism: A coaches its former speech pupil to name the actual stage repair and what it enabled rather than dissolve A wet-weather effort into equal thanks.
confusable: Not merely wanting a name printed: A insists the acknowledgment connect its specific work to dancers being able to perform.
comparison: Public speech naming physical effort versus committee account naming recovered trip records.
seedUse: D201 stage/rain/team/equal thanks/dancers; S05 taught concrete speech verbs.
